versions.changelog:
Initial release of the thought-flow skill.

- Introduces an 8-stage collaboration loop: INTENT, CONSTRAINTS, PROPOSE, PRESS, PRACTICE, INVESTIGATE, CODIFY, BOUNDARY-CHECK.
- Provides detailed descriptions and guidance for each stage.
- Emphasizes iterative, collaborative refinement between user and agent.
- Outlines best practices for proposal, verification, and knowledge codification.
- Adds verification checklist to ensure effective use of the loop.
